# MAPSKART - Luxury Handcrafted Fashion Jewellery

> MAPSKART (A Think Trend) is an Indian luxury fashion jewellery brand based in Delhi, India. We craft anti-tarnish, hypoallergenic, skin-safe jewellery made with premium plating and sparkling zircon/crystals, designed for everyday wear, festive celebrations, and wedding ceremonies.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: MAPSKART (A Think Trend)
- **Tagline**: Considered jewellery for people who choose once and wear often. Handled by small ateliers, curated in Delhi.
- **Product Range**: Earrings, Necklaces, Bridal Sets, Chokers, Solitaire Studs, Rings, and Bracelets.
- **Craftsmanship**: High-grade anti-tarnish coating, water/sweat resistant, 100% skin-safe & hypoallergenic.
- **Signature Packaging**:
  - Earrings: Includes luxury velvet jewellery box.
  - Necklaces & Sets: Includes luxury velvet jewellery pouch.
- **Headquarters**: Delhi, India
- **Customer Support Email**: mapskart.info.in@gmail.com
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/mapskart_official
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61593981695975

## Collections
- [Earrings](https://mapskart.info.in/collections/earrings/): Solitaire studs, royal radiant crystals, halo drops, geometric drops, and multi-colour baguette crown earrings.
- [Necklaces & Bridal Sets](https://mapskart.info.in/collections/necklaces/): Heritage bridal sets with matching maang tikka, tiara flow necklaces, and luxury statement bloom sets.
- [Rings](https://mapskart.info.in/collections/rings/): Premium zircon and solitaire fashion rings.
- [Bracelets](https://mapskart.info.in/collections/bracelets/): Elegant anti-tarnish cuffs and charm bracelets.
- [Layered Necklaces](https://mapskart.info.in/collections/layered-necklaces/): Modern multi-strand and layered chains.

## Offers & Gifting
- **Buy One Get One (BOGO)**: Selected products qualify for automatic free luxury gifts chosen during checkout.
- **Free Shipping**: Complimentary insured express delivery across India on orders above ₹999.
- **Luxury Gift Ready**: Every order is pre-packed in our signature velvet packaging with branded unboxing elements.

---

## Orders, Payments & Policy
- **Payment Modes**: 100% secure payment via Paytm QR code / UPI apps (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm).
- **Non-Returnable Policy**: To maintain strict hygiene and purity standards for personal jewellery, all items are non-returnable.
- **Instant Order Tracking**: WhatsApp confirmation and tracking updates sent for all dispatched parcels.
